Non si tratta solo di migliorare gli edifici – si tratta di creare ambienti efficienti, sicuri, adattabili e sostenibili, che migliorano il modo in cui il mondo vive e lavora. La trasformazione digitale degli edifici è un settore dinamico in rapida evoluzione, e ha bisogno di più di una semplice grande tecnologia - ha bisogno anche di grandi persone. Sappiamo che un'impresa prospera solo se la sua gente sta prosperando, quindi a Siemens mettiamo la nostra gente prima. descriptionByLocale.en:
We transform buildings With technology for smart and sustainable buildings and infrastructure, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and achieve world-class experiences for people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. In our mission to improve the world’s infrastructure, we are seeking Test Lab Infrastructure Assistant Working Student   for our Services organization within our   Buildings Smart   Infrastructure business unit. Are you a proactive and detail-oriented individual looking to contribute to a dynamic test lab environment? As a working student, you are an important part of our #TeamSiemens Switzerland. We offer a flexible and open workplace culture for   an optimal   balance between studies &   work experience as well as private life. Why not find out for yourself and apply for our position? Location:   Zug – Switzerland   Role The Test Lab Infrastructure Assistant Working student will be supporting our team in Zug. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and play a crucial part in ensuring the quality of our releases. Your new responsibilities
• Fire Alarm Environment Support: Your primary focus will be on our fire alarm systems. This includes installing, managing updates, and performing integration testing of new release versions within our test lab
• Virtualization Infrastructure Assistance: You'll also help support our virtualization infrastructure by creating new virtual clients, managing client and infrastructure backups, and maintaining our network Your talents and experience
• You are enrolled at a Swiss university of university of applied sciences in the Information technology or Computer Science- Cyber Security OR you are taking a gap year between Bachelor’s and master’s studies
• Basic understanding of IT infrastructure, including Windows environments, virtualization, and networking concepts
• Have experience with (but not essential, as training will be provided) with: Fire alarm systems, Windows Client and Server deployment, Proxmox VE, Cisco & MikroTik network devices
• Collaborative mindset with a strong team-oriented mindset, while demonstrating the initiative, accountability, and self-management required to deliver results independently
• Have a keen interest in technology and a desire to learn are essential
• Possess the ability to quickly learn and apply new skills will be key to your success
• Be a motivated and proactive student with excellent problem-solving skills and a dedicated, results-oriented work style
• Proficiency in English is required, and German is a plus
• Hybrid role: 2 days onsite / 1 remote (if 60%) Employee benefits
• Mobile working from anywhere within Switzerland
• Opportunity to develop an international professional network
• Gain experience at one of the largest tech employers in Switzerland
• Membership in the Siemens Students Association comprising 200 members Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our day-to-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and remote working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a good work-life balance. Learn more and find out if you are a good match with Siemens by taking our culture quiz ! “ What I particularly appreciate is the flexibility for student trainees. My studies are always in the foreground. ” (Working Student Product Management) Frequently asked questions and contact information Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions and a way to contact us directly. I look forward to receiving your application. Thank you for your understanding.

Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. As one of the leading technology companies, Siemens employs around 6,000 people in Switzerland. With our groundbreaking solutions in the areas of building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry, we are shaping the future. Are you excited about the fast-growing world of electric vehicle (EV) charging? Our Charger Operations team consists of innovators, problem solvers and leaders who drive the future of sustainable transport. As a remote service engineer, you’ll diagnose, repair and repair EV charging systems remotely, supporting field service engineers and customers. This role offers a path to further development in the areas of Customer Success, Technical Leadership or Post-Sale Project Management. Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people in Switzerland better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply today as a service coordinator: in and start immediately or according to your availability – your team is looking forward to you! Your new tasks
• Coordination of on-site service activities, ensuring testing and functionality of products after service, and defining the scope of work for field engineers
• Diagnosing, troubleshooting and solving technical problems with EV charging systems by telephone, email and remote access; Contact person for field service engineers and customers; Management of the process from initial troubleshooting to final resolution
• Escalation and management of cases from First Line Customer Support, accompanying them from beginning to end and ensuring first-class service
• Applying creativity and technical expertise to solve complex problems remotely, ensuring a timely solution within key account SLA deadlines
• Planning and supporting on-site operations with service partners or field engineers, adapting solutions to regional needs
• Escalating issues to Tier 3 Support when necessary to ensure proper expertise
• Guiding First Line Customer Support Teams and delivering training to empower others and empower the team with your talents and experiences
• Technical background: A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electromechanics, IT or equivalent training with practical experience in maintenance or planning of electrical installations.
• Communication skills: Negotiating knowledge of German and English with the ability to work effectively in diverse, multicultural teams. Knowledge of other languages is a plus.
• Self-employment and initiative: You are a self-initiative person who likes to work independently and is looking for learning and development opportunities in a dynamic environment.
• Curiosity and problem solving: solution-oriented thinking, gladly accept challenges.
• Adaptability and resilience: Ability to succeed in rapidly changing environments and adapt to new challenges. Your advantages
• 2–3 days/week mobile work is standard
• Discounted ÖV subscription and free parking
• Diverse training opportunities
• Access to employee stock plans

descriptionByLocale.en:
We transform buildings With technology for smart and sustainable buildings and infrastructure, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and achieve world-class experiences for people Within Siemens Smart Infrastructure, you will be part of our Buildings Business Unit, which brings together the full portfolio of products, software and services for buildings and adjacent infrastructure In our quest to revolutionize the world’s infrastructure, we are seeking an experienced Lead Data Product Owner, for our SI SW Organization, within our SI Buildings business unit Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go? Location: This position will be in Zug, Switzerland. Please note that qualified candidates need to be legally eligible for work authorization in Switzerland The Role As our new Lead Data Product Owner (LDPO), you’ll work across data domains, technical units, and diverse data sources, from IoT devices, cloud platforms and IT systems to core business processes. You’ll coordinate with key stakeholders, both business and technical, to deliver high-quality data products that power innovative services and unlock new business opportunities Your new responsibilities -Vision and Strategy: Define the vision and roadmap for data products, aligned with business strategy end-to-end and across different parts of the organization -Product Backlog Management: Own and prioritize the data product backlog to maximize business value by monitoring performance, gathering feedback, and iterating on product features -Stakeholder Management : Engage stakeholders across business units, data science and engineering to gather requirements and communicate progress -Team Leadership: Guide and mentor a virtual team of Data Product Owners to ensure effective product development -Data Governance and Quality: ensure that data products adhere to quality standards and meet legal requirements -Innovation: Identify and drive opportunities for data innovation and AI Your Profile
• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or similar
• Given the breadth of the product's scope, 5 years plus of experience in data or product management with strong organizational skills
• Previous experience in the technical building domain (automation, energy, security) is a strong plus
• Good understanding of data governance principles, data quality management, metadata practices, and regulatory requirements
• Proven experience defining, delivering, and evolving data products, with a strong focus on business value, adoption, and measurable outcomes
• Experience identifying and driving AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics in products
• Solid understanding of data technologies (databases, catalogues, data lakes) to steer product decisions and discussions
• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior business and technical stakeholders
• Proactive, collaborative and able to influence stakeholders
• Strong analytical mindset with a passion for digital solutions and adoption
• Fluent in English, written and spoken Employee benefits
• 2–3 days per week of mobile working is standard
• Mobility allowance
• Varied further training opportunities
• Access to employee share programs

Crea un #Tomorrow Better WithUs Vuoi contribuire a plasmare il futuro del mondo ferroviario insieme a noi? In Siemens Mobility siamo il fornitore leader della mobilità, ampliando costantemente il nostro portafoglio innovativo, che comprende veicoli ferroviari, automazione ferroviaria, soluzioni di elettrificazione, sistemi ferroviari completi e servizi di accompagnamento. Con circa 750 dipendenti specializzati in Svizzera e 39 600 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, formiamo la mobilità con passione e siamo un passo avanti rispetto al nostro tempo. Sei la forza trainante per la qualità e il miglioramento continuo in tutte le fasi del progetto all'interno della nostra area di esecuzione del progetto per Rail Infrastructure. Allo stesso tempo, si apprezza la diversità del business del progetto e, se necessario, anche sostenere i compiti adiacenti nel coordinamento del progetto. Con la tua mentalità pratica, ti impegni dove il team di progetto ha bisogno di supporto e si sviluppi continuamente in nuovi argomenti. Il tuo nuovo ruolo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Insieme ai nostri clienti, uniamo i mondi reali e digitali Con tecnologia, software e servizi per edifici intelligenti, trasformiamo il quotidiano per tutti. Combinando i mondi reali e digitali, possiamo permettere ai nostri clienti di raggiungere i loro obiettivi di decarbonizzazione, abbassare i costi operativi e creare esperienze occupanti di livello mondiale per la loro gente. Non si tratta solo di migliorare gli edifici – si tratta di creare ambienti efficienti, sicuri, adattabili e sostenibili, che migliorano il modo in cui il mondo vive e lavora. La trasformazione digitale degli edifici è un settore dinamico in rapida evoluzione, e ha bisogno di più di una semplice grande tecnologia - ha bisogno anche di grandi persone. Sappiamo che un'impresa prospera solo se la sua gente sta prosperando, quindi a Siemens mettiamo la nostra gente prima. All'interno del nostro business di edifici, il nostro team globale diversificato vi sosterrà attraverso la vostra carriera e vi sfiderà a crescere in modi nuovi ed eccitanti, come trasformiamo l'infrastruttura del mondo. Come Data Scientist, trasformerai dati, conoscenze di dominio e metodi AI avanzati in funzionalità scalabili, misurabili e affidabili per SI Buildings Product (SI B PRO). Si tratta di un ruolo di alto impatto per un AI hands-on e un professionista dei dati che vuole lavorare al centro di un nuovo team modellando come AI Generativo, machine learning, e il processo decisionale basato sui dati vengono applicati attraverso lo sviluppo del prodotto. In questo ruolo, contribuirai alla progettazione, al prototipo, alla validazione e alla operativizzazione delle soluzioni abilitate all'IA nei cicli di sviluppo software e firmware. Porterai una forte esperienza analitica, statistica e machine learning per trasformare i dati di ingegneria complessi in insight, modelli, framework di valutazione e dati riutilizzabili. Lavorando all'incrocio tra scienza dei dati, ingegneria dell'intelligenza artificiale e sviluppo dei prodotti, vi aiuterà a garantire che le iniziative dell'IA non siano solo innovative, ma anche robuste, spiegabili, preziose per i team di ingegneria, sicure e conformi. Vorresti anche svolgere un ruolo attivo nell'influenzare le tendenze e gli sviluppi attuali e avere un impatto positivo sulla vita di milioni di persone in Svizzera? Allora siete venuti nel posto giusto! Applicare oggi per la posizione di AI Data Scientist – il vostro team è impaziente di incontrarvi! Le nuove responsabilità
• Progettazione, sviluppo e convalida dell'apprendimento automatico, AI Generativo e soluzioni di analisi avanzate che supportano lo sviluppo del prodotto, la produttività ingegneristica, il miglioramento della qualità, la sicurezza informatica e il processo decisionale attraverso il nostro SDLC
• Sostenere lo sviluppo delle capacità AI-assistite e agentic attraverso l'ingegneria dei requisiti, l'analisi dell'architettura, la codifica, il test, la sicurezza, la gestione delle vulnerabilità, la prontezza del rilascio e la gestione del ciclo di vita applicando i metodi di scienza dei dati ai flussi di lavoro reali di ingegneria
• Costruire prototipi, prove-de-concetti e pipeline di valutazione per applicazioni basate su LLM, soluzioni RAG, flussi di lavoro agentici, modelli di classificazione, modelli di previsione e casi di utilizzo di ingegneria assistiti da AI, assicurando che la fattibilità, la qualità e il valore misurabile siano valutati precocemente e continuamente
• Identificare, acquisire, pulire, strutturare e arricchire i dati da toolchains di ingegneria, repository, documentazione, requisiti, sistemi di test, fonti di vulnerabilità e piattaforme aziendali per renderlo utilizzabile per soluzioni AI e analytics
• Definire e implementare approcci di valutazione, metriche di performance, metodi di validazione, concetti di monitoraggio e criteri di qualità per i modelli AI e applicazioni GenAI, con attenzione alla spiegabilità, robustezza, pregiudizi, privacy, sicurezza e principi AI responsabili
• Creare set di dati riutilizzabili, incorporazioni, negozi di funzionalità, notebook, pipeline, attività di valutazione dei modelli e documentazione che consentono l'adozione scalabile e la consegna ripetibile delle capacità AI in team e casi di utilizzo
• Esplora le tecniche, i framework e gli strumenti emergenti di AI, machine learning, data science e GenAI e valutarne l'applicabilità per i casi di utilizzo di SI B PRO in collaborazione con il team AI Core e gli stakeholder di ingegneria I tuoi talenti ed esperienza
• Corso di laurea o Master in Scienza dei dati, Scienza informatica, Intelligenza artificiale, Statistica, Matematica, Ingegneria del software, Fisica, o un campo tecnico correlato
• Diversi anni di esperienza pratica nella scienza dei dati, nell'apprendimento automatico, nell'ingegneria dell'intelligenza artificiale, nell'analisi applicata o in ruoli tecnici correlati, idealmente in ambienti di ingegneria o tecnologia industriale
• Buona comprensione delle fondazioni di ingegneria dei dati, tra cui datadotti, API, database, versione, qualità dei dati, metadati e sperimentazione riproducibile
• Forte esperienza pratica con linguaggi di programmazione e ecosistemi comuni di data science e machine learning, tra cui elaborazione dati, sviluppo di modelli, sperimentazione, valutazione e visualizzazione
• Comprensione dei cicli di vita di sviluppo del software e del firmware, pratiche DevSecOps, considerazioni sulla sicurezza informatica e come l'IA può supportare i flussi di lavoro di ingegneria in modo sicuro e scalabile
• L'esposizione manuale alle soluzioni AI Generative, comprese le applicazioni basate su LLM, l'ingegneria rapida, le embeddings, la generazione in aumento, la valutazione delle uscite GenAI e i flussi di lavoro AI idealmente agentici e l'esperienza con i metodi di machine learning
• Capacità di lavorare con dati ingegneristici complessi ed eterogenei, quali requisiti, metadati di codice sorgente, risultati di test, registri, documentazione, informazioni di vulnerabilità e artefatti del ciclo di vita
• Consapevolezza della governance dell'IA, privacy, AI responsabile, rischio di modello, spiegabilità e aspettative normative rilevanti per l'adozione dell'IA aziendale
• Buone capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione, con la capacità di spiegare i concetti di scienza dei dati a architetti, proprietari di prodotti, ingegneri, esperti di sicurezza informatica e stakeholder aziendali

descriptionByLocale.en:
Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure. As a Data Scientist, you will turn data, domain knowledge, and advanced AI methods into scalable, measurable, and trustworthy capabilities for SI Buildings Product (SI B PRO). This is a high-impact role for a hands-on AI and data professional who wants to work at the center of a new team shaping how Generative AI, machine learning, and data-driven decision-making are applied across product development. In this role, you will contribute to design, prototype, validate, and operationalize AI-enabled solutions across software and firmware development lifecycles. You will bring strong analytical, statistical, and machine learning expertise to transform complex engineering data into insights, models, evaluation frameworks, and reusable data products. Working at the intersection of data science, AI engineering and product development, you will help ensure that AI initiatives are not only innovative, but also robust, explainable, valuable for engineering teams, secure and compliant. Would you also like to play an active role in influencing current trends and developments and make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then you’ve come to the right place! Apply today for the position of AI Data Scientist – your team is looking forward to meeting you! Your new responsibilities
• Design, develop, and validate machine learning, Generative AI, and advanced analytics solutions that support product development, engineering productivity, quality improvement, cybersecurity, and decision-making across our SDLC
• Support the development of AI-assisted and agentic capabilities across requirements engineering, architecture analysis, coding, testing, security, vulnerability management, release readiness, and lifecycle management by applying data science methods to real engineering workflows
• Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and evaluation pipelines for LLM-based applications, RAG solutions, agentic workflows, classification models, prediction models, and AI-assisted engineering use cases, ensuring that feasibility, quality, and measurable value are assessed early and continuously
• Identify, acquire, clean, structure, and enrich data from engineering toolchains, repositories, documentation, requirements, test systems, vulnerability sources, and enterprise platforms to make it usable for AI and analytics solutions
• Define and implement evaluation approaches, performance metrics, validation methods, monitoring concepts, and quality criteria for AI models and GenAI applications, with attention to explainability, robustness, bias, privacy, security, and responsible AI principles
• Create reusable datasets, embeddings, feature stores, notebooks, pipelines, model evaluation assets, and documentation that enable scalable adoption and repeatable delivery of AI capabilities across teams and use cases
• Explore emerging AI, machine learning, data science, and GenAI techniques, frameworks, and tools, and assess their applicability for SI B PRO use cases in collaboration with the AI Core team and engineering stakeholders Your talents and experience
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field
• Several years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, AI engineering, applied analytics, or related technical roles, ideally in engineering or industrial technology environments (min. 5 years)
• Good understanding of data engineering foundations, including data pipelines, APIs, databases, versioning, data quality, metadata, and reproducible experimentation
• Strong practical experience with programming languages and common data science and machine learning ecosystems, including data processing, model development, experimentation, evaluation, and visualization
• Understanding of software and firmware development lifecycles, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity considerations, and how AI can support engineering workflows in a secure and scalable way
• Hands-on exposure to Generative AI solutions, including LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation of GenAI outputs, and ideally agentic AI workflows and experience with machine learning methods
• Ability to work with complex and heterogeneous engineering data, such as requirements, source code metadata, test results, logs, documentation, vulnerability information, and lifecycle artifacts
• Awareness of AI governance, privacy, responsible AI, model risk, explainability, and regulatory expectations relevant to enterprise AI adoption
• Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain data science concepts to architects, product owners, engineers, cybersecurity experts, and business stakeholders
• Fluent in English Employee benefits
• 2–3 days per week of mobile working is standard
• Mobility allowance
• Varied further training opportunities
• Access to employee share programs
• Further information about employee benefits can be found here Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our day-to-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and remote working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a good work-life balance. Als Data Scientist verwandeln Sie Daten, Domänenwissen und fortschrittliche KI-Methoden in skalierbare, messbare und vertrauenswürdige Funktionen für SI Buildings Product (SI B PRO). Dies ist eine wichtige Rolle für einen praktischen KI- und Datenexperten, der im Zentrum eines neuen Teams arbeiten möchte, um zu gestalten, wie Generative KI, maschinelles Lernen und datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung in der Produktentwicklung angewendet werden. Sie bringen starke analytische, statistische und maschinelles Lernen mit, um komplexe technische Daten in Erkenntnisse, Modelle, Bewertungsrahmen und wiederverwendbare Datenprodukte umzuwandeln. An der Schnittstelle von Data Science, KI-Engineering und Produktentwicklung helfen Sie sicherzustellen, dass KI-Initiativen nicht nur innovativ, sondern auch robust, erklärbar, wertvoll für Engineering-Teams, sicher und konform sind. • Entwerfen, Entwickeln und Validieren von maschinellem Lernen, Generativer KI und fortschrittlichen Analyselösungen, die Produktentwicklung, technische Produktivität, Qualitätsverbesserung, Cybersicherheit und Entscheidungsfindung in unserem SDLC unterstützen

Nous savons qu'une entreprise ne prospère que si ses gens prospèrent, donc chez Siemens nous mettons nos gens en premier. Au sein de notre entreprise immobilière, notre équipe mondiale diversifiée vous accompagnera dans votre carrière et vous mettra au défi de croître de nouvelles façons passionnantes, alors que nous transformons l'infrastructure mondiale. En tant que Data Scientist, vous transformerez les données, les connaissances du domaine et les méthodes avancées d'IA en capacités évolutives, mesurables et fiables pour SI Buildings Product (SI B PRO). Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact pour un professionnel de l'IA et des données qui veut travailler au centre d'une nouvelle équipe façonnant la façon dont l'IA Generative, l'apprentissage automatique et la prise de décision axée sur les données sont appliqués à travers le développement de produits. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à la conception, au prototype, à la validation et à l'opérationnalisation de solutions compatibles avec l'IA dans tous les cycles de développement de logiciels et de firmware. Vous apporterez une solide expertise analytique, statistique et d'apprentissage automatique pour transformer des données d'ingénierie complexes en idées, modèles, cadres d'évaluation et produits de données réutilisables. Travaillant à l'intersection de la science des données, de l'ingénierie de l'IA et du développement de produits, vous vous assurerez que les initiatives d'IA ne sont pas seulement innovantes, mais aussi robustes, explicables, précieuses pour les équipes d'ingénierie, sécurisées et conformes. Aimeriez-vous également jouer un rôle actif dans l'influence des tendances et des évolutions actuelles et avoir un impact positif sur la vie de millions de personnes en Suisse? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit ! Postulez aujourd'hui au poste de spécialiste des données sur l'IA – votre équipe est impatiente de vous rencontrer! Vos nouvelles responsabilités
• Conception, développement et validation de solutions d'apprentissage automatique, d'IA Generative et d'analyse avancée qui soutiennent le développement de produits, la productivité d'ingénierie, l'amélioration de la qualité, la cybersécurité et la prise de décisions dans notre SDLC
• Appuyer le développement de capacités d'intelligence artificielle et d'agents à l'échelle de l'ingénierie des besoins, de l'analyse de l'architecture, du codage, des essais, de la sécurité, de la gestion de la vulnérabilité, de l'état de préparation aux rejets et de la gestion du cycle de vie en appliquant des méthodes de science des données à de véritables flux de travail en génie
• Construisez des prototypes, des preuves de conception et des pipelines d'évaluation pour les applications basées sur la LLM, les solutions RAG, les flux de travail des agents, les modèles de classification, les modèles de prédiction et les cas d'utilisation assistée par l'intelligence artificielle, en veillant à ce que la faisabilité, la qualité et la valeur mesurable soient évaluées rapidement et en continu
• Identifier, acquérir, nettoyer, structurer et enrichir les données des chaînes d'outils d'ingénierie, des dépôts, de la documentation, des exigences, des systèmes d'essai, des sources de vulnérabilité et des plateformes d'entreprise pour les rendre utilisables pour les solutions d'IA et d'analyse
• Définir et mettre en œuvre des approches d'évaluation, des mesures de rendement, des méthodes de validation, des concepts de surveillance et des critères de qualité pour les modèles d'IA et les applications GenAI, en tenant compte de l'explication, de la robustesse, des biais, de la confidentialité, de la sécurité et des principes d'IA responsables
• Créer des ensembles de données réutilisables, des ancrages, des magasins de fonctionnalités, des carnets, des pipelines, des outils d'évaluation de modèles et de la documentation qui permettent l'adoption évolutive et la transmission répétable des capacités d'intelligence artificielle entre les équipes et les cas d'utilisation
• Explorez les techniques, les cadres et les outils de l'IA, de l'apprentissage automatique, de la science des données et de l'IAG, et évaluez leur applicabilité aux cas d'utilisation de SI B PRO en collaboration avec l'équipe de base de l'IA et les intervenants en génie Vos talents et votre expérience
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences des données, informatique, intelligence artificielle, statistique, mathématiques, génie logiciel, physique ou un domaine technique connexe
• Plusieurs années d'expérience pratique dans les sciences des données, l'apprentissage automatique, l'ingénierie de l'IA, l'analyse appliquée ou les rôles techniques connexes, idéalement dans les environnements d'ingénierie ou de technologie industrielle
• Bonne compréhension des fondements de l'ingénierie des données, y compris les pipelines de données, les API, les bases de données, la version, la qualité des données, les métadonnées et l'expérimentation reproductible
• Forte expérience pratique des langages de programmation et des écosystèmes communs de la science des données et de l'apprentissage automatique, y compris le traitement des données, l'élaboration de modèles, l'expérimentation, l'évaluation et la visualisation
• Compréhension du cycle de vie des logiciels et des firmwares, des pratiques DevSecOps, des considérations de cybersécurité et de la façon dont l'IA peut soutenir les flux de travail d'ingénierie de manière sécurisée et évolutive
• Exposition directe à des solutions d'IA Generative, y compris des applications basées sur LLM, une ingénierie rapide, des emboîtements, une génération augmentée par récupération, l'évaluation des sorties de GenAI, et idéalement des workflows d'IA agentiques et de l'expérience avec les méthodes d'apprentissage automatique
• Capacité de travailler avec des données d'ingénierie complexes et hétérogènes, comme les exigences, les métadonnées du code source, les résultats des essais, les journaux, la documentation, l'information sur la vulnérabilité et les artefacts du cycle de vie
• Connaissance de la gouvernance de l'IA, de la vie privée, de l'IA responsable, du risque de modèle, de l'explicabilité et des attentes réglementaires pertinentes pour l'adoption de l'IA par l'entreprise
• Bonnes compétences en communication et collaboration, avec la capacité d'expliquer les concepts de la science des données aux architectes, aux propriétaires de produits, aux ingénieurs, aux experts en cybersécurité et aux intervenants commerciaux

As a working student, intern or trainee, you are an important part of our #TeamSiemens at the Zug location. • You have the ability to understand and structure complex system architectures
• You convince through an independent, careful and structured working method as well as strong communication skills
• Very good German and English skills are required for the activity Your advantages

At Siemens Mobility, we are the leading provider of mobility and are constantly expanding our innovative portfolio, which includes rail vehicles, rail automation, electrification solutions, complete rail systems and accompanying services. With around 800 specialist employees in Switzerland and 39 600 employees worldwide, we shape mobility with passion and are one step ahead of our time. In this key role, you skillfully connect technology, strategy and business development, driving innovation with real market impact. Your team provides tools and processes for efficient and economical project implementation. Become part of our management team and develop business, products and organization sustainably. descriptionByLocale.it:
#TomorrowWithUs Vuoi contribuire a plasmare il futuro del mondo ferroviario insieme a noi? In Siemens Mobility siamo il fornitore leader della mobilità e in costante espansione il nostro portafoglio innovativo, che comprende veicoli ferroviari, automazione ferroviaria, soluzioni di elettrificazione, sistemi ferroviari completi e servizi di accompagnamento. Con circa 800 dipendenti specializzati in Svizzera e 39 600 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, formiamo la mobilità con passione e siamo un passo avanti rispetto al nostro tempo. Come project manager, assumerai una posizione chiave nella gestione e nel coordinamento dei progetti nel campo dello sviluppo software basato su cloud per i nostri clienti ferroviari. Condurre lo sviluppo e i progetti dei clienti in questo ambiente e lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni, nonché con partner esterni e clienti per realizzare soluzioni innovative e orientate al mercato. Per questa posizione, siamo alla ricerca di una persona impegnata con la passione per i progetti software innovativi, il godimento del lavoro di squadra e l'entusiasmo per sviluppare software basati su cloud utilizzando metodi di progetto agili. I vostri doveri e responsabilità
• Pianifica, controlla e monitora i progetti di sviluppo software nell'ambiente cloud. Assicurarsi che i progetti sono completati in tempo e costi, così come in base alle esigenze. Ciò include anche la definizione degli obiettivi del progetto, la distribuzione dei compiti, la gestione dei rischi e la garanzia della qualità.
• Si mantiene stretti rapporti con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, come i clienti nell'ambiente ferroviario, partner o altri dipartimenti all'interno di Siemens. Capite i requisiti delle parti interessate e assicuratevi che le soluzioni software sviluppate soddisfino le loro esigenze. Comunica gli stati e i risultati del progetto agli stakeholder in modo indirizzabile.
• Sei l'interfaccia tra sviluppo, ingegneria e gestione dei prodotti, così come i clienti. Si coordina con questi corpi e il team tecnico di base e quindi garantire un'implementazione di progetto regolare.
• Lavori a stretto contatto con il nostro team di sviluppo internazionale per sviluppare soluzioni innovative nell'ambiente ferroviario. Identificare il potenziale per ottimizzare i processi esistenti e guidare l'introduzione di nuove tecnologie e metodi. I vostri talenti e competenze
• Talento nella strutturazione e nel controllo dei progetti di sviluppo software nell'ambiente CloudNative
• Entusiasmo per progetti tecnici e la capacità di comunicare contesti tecnici complessi in modo comprensibile
• Conoscenza pratica approfondita delle tecnologie cloud e dell'esperienza nell'architettura e nella programmazione dei sistemi software basati sul cloud nel settore industriale
• Apertura a nuove sfide e gestione flessibile dei requisiti di cambiamento
• Esperienza nell'ingegneria ferroviaria auspicabile
• Studi tecnici completi (ETH, FH) o esperienza rilevante
• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese Se siete alla ricerca di un ruolo dinamico in un ambiente tecnico altamente innovativo in cui si contribuisce in modo significativo all'ulteriore sviluppo e implementazione dei nostri progetti, allora siete nel posto giusto! Vi offriamo l'opportunità di contribuire alla vostra esperienza, lavorare con un team altamente motivato e guidare soluzioni innovative insieme. Diventa parte del nostro team e modella il futuro alla Siemens Mobility. Lei beneficia di
• una cultura di lavoro aperta e flessibile in una delle aziende leader nel campo della mobilità in Svizzera
• una settimana di 40 ore su un costo del 100%
• almeno 5 settimane di vacanze
• un posto di lavoro al polso della tecnologia ferroviaria
• Vari vantaggi e opportunità di formazione dei dipendenti

descriptionByLocale.en:
Create a better #TomorrowWithUs Want to help shape the future of the railway world together with us? At Siemens Mobility, we are the leading provider of mobility and are constantly expanding our innovative portfolio, which includes rail vehicles, rail automation, electrification solutions, complete rail systems and accompanying services. With around 800 specialist employees in Switzerland and 39 600 employees worldwide, we shape mobility with passion and are one step ahead of our time. As a project manager, you will assume a key position in the management and coordination of projects in the field of cloud-based software development for our rail customers. You lead the development and customer projects in this environment and work closely with internal stakeholders as well as external partners and customers to realize innovative and market-oriented solutions. For this position, we are looking for a committed person with a passion for innovative software projects, enjoyment of teamwork and enthusiasm to develop cloud-based software using agile project methods. Your duties and responsibilities
• You plan, control and monitor software development projects in the cloud environment. You ensure that the projects are completed on time and cost as well as according to the requirements. This also includes the definition of project objectives, the distribution of tasks, risk management and quality assurance.
• You maintain close relationships with internal and external stakeholders, such as customers in the railway environment, partners or other departments within Siemens. You understand the requirements of the stakeholders and ensure that the developed software solutions meet their needs. You communicate project statuses and results to the stakeholders in an addressable manner.
• You are the interface between development, engineering and product management as well as the customers. You coordinate with these bodies and the core technical team and thus ensure a smooth project implementation.
• You work closely with our international development team to develop innovative solutions in the railway environment. You identify potential for optimizing existing processes and drive the introduction of new technologies and methods. Your talents and skills
• Talent in structuring and controlling software development projects in the CloudNative environment
• Enthusiasm for technical projects and the ability to communicate complex technical contexts in an understandable way
• In-depth practical knowledge in cloud technologies and experience in architecture and programming of cloud-based software systems in the industrial sector
• Openness to new challenges and flexible handling of changing requirements
• Expertise in railway engineering desirable
• Completed technical studies (ETH, FH) or relevant experience
• Very good knowledge of German and English If you are looking for a dynamic role in a highly innovative technical environment in which you contribute significantly to the further development and implementation of our projects, then you are in the right place! We offer you the opportunity to contribute your expertise, work with a highly motivated team and drive innovative solutions together. Become part of our team and shape the future at Siemens Mobility. You benefit from
• an open and flexible working culture at one of the leading companies in the field of mobility in Switzerland
• a 40-hour week on a 100% fee
• at least 5 weeks of holidays
• a workplace at the pulse of railway technology
• Various employee benefits and training opportunities
• a hybrid working model: balanced work-life balance and more autonomy Our team and location You want information about our culture, our values, diversity and other important topics? Find out why Siemens is voted one of the most popular employers in Switzerland every year and get an insight into your new working environment today: Siemens Mobility CV Siemens Mobility as an employer Video Siemens Mobility Interested? Apply today with your CV online on our application platform (button "COMPETITION"). We accept applications exclusively through our application platform. For this position, only direct applications are considered. Answers to the most common questions and a contact form can be found at siemens.ch/contact-hr. We look forward to your full application. Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens does not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs Willst du gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Bahnwelt mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Mobility sind der führende Anbieter im Bereich der Mobilität und erweitern ständig unser innovatives Portfolio, das Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierung, Elektrifizierungslösungen, komplette Bahnsysteme und begleitende Dienstleistungen umfasst. Mit rund 800 Fachmitarbeitenden in der Schweiz und 39 600 Mitarbeitenden weltweit gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind unserer Zeit einen Schritt voraus. Als Projektleiter:in übernimmst du eine Schlüsselposition in der Leitung und Koordination von Projekten im Bereich der cloud-basierten Software-Entwicklung für unsere Bahnkunden. Du leitest die Entwicklungs- und Kundenprojekte in diesem Umfeld und arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern sowie externen Partnern und Kundinnen zusammen, um innovative und marktorientierte Lösungen zu verwirklichen. Wir suchen für diese Position eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit einer Leidenschaft für innovative Software-Projekte, Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie der Begeisterung, mit agilen Projektmethoden cloud-basierte Software zu entwickeln. Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
• Du planst, steuerst und überwachst Software-Entwicklungsprojekte im Cloud-Umfeld. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Projekte termin- und kostengerecht sowie gemäss den Anforderungen abgeschlossen werden. Dazu gehören auch die Definition von Projektzielen, die Aufgabenverteilung, das Risikomanagement und die Qualitätssicherung.
• Du pflegst enge Beziehungen zu internen und externen Stakeholdern, wie beispielsweise Kundinnen im Bahnumfeld, Partnern oder anderen Abteilungen innerhalb von Siemens. Du verstehst die Anforderungen der Stakeholder und sorgst dafür, dass die entwickelten Software-Lösungen deren Bedürfnissen gerecht werden. Du kommunizierst Projektstände und Ergebnisse adressatengerecht an die Stakeholder.
• Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklung, Engineering und Produktmanagement sowie den Kunden. Du koordinierst dich mit diesen Stellen sowie dem technischen Kernteam und sorgst so für eine reibungslose Projektumsetzung.
• Du arbeitest eng mit unserem internationalen Entwicklungsteam zusammen, um innovative Lösungen im Bahnumfeld zu entwickeln. Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Optimierung bestehender Prozesse und treibst die Einführung neuer Technologien und Methoden voran. Deine Talente und Fähigkeiten
• Talent in der Strukturierung und Steuerung von Software-Entwicklungs-Projekten im CloudNative-Umfeld
• Begeisterung für technische Projekte und die Fähigkeit komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu kommunizieren
• Tiefgreifendes praktisches Wissen in Cloud-Technologien und Erfahrung in Architektur und Programmierung von cloud-basierten Software-Systemen im Industrie-Bereich
• Offenheit für neue Herausforderungen und flexibler Umgang mit sich ändernden Anforderungen
• Fachwissen in der Bahnleittechnik wünschenswert
• Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (ETH, FH) oder relevante Erfahrung
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Wenn du eine dynamische Rolle in einem hochinnovativen technischen Umfeld suchst, in welchem du massgeblich zur Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Projekte beiträgst, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, dein Fachwissen einzubringen, mit einem hochmotivierten Team zusammenzuarbeiten und gemeinsam innovative Lösungen voranzutreiben. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte die Zukunft bei Siemens Mobility mit. Du profitierst von
• einer offenen und flexiblen Arbeitskultur bei einem der führenden Unternehmen im Bereich der Mobilität in der Schweiz
• einer 40-Stunden-Woche bei einem 100%-Pensum
• mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien
• einem Arbeitsplatz am Puls der Bahntechnik
• diversen Mitarbeitervergünstigungen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
• einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell: ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance und mehr Autonomie Unser Team und Standort Du möchtest Informationen über unsere Kultur, unsere Werte, Diversity und andere wichtige Themen? Erfahre hier, weshalb Siemens jedes Jahr zu einem der beliebtesten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz gewählt wird, und gewinne schon heute einen Einblick in dein neues Arbeitsumfeld: Siemens Mobility CV Siemens Mobility als Arbeitgeber Video Siemens Mobility Interessiert? Créer un meilleur #DemainWithUs Vous voulez aider à façonner l'avenir du monde ferroviaire avec nous ? Chez Siemens Mobility, nous sommes le premier fournisseur de mobilité et nous développons constamment notre portefeuille innovant, qui comprend des véhicules ferroviaires, l'automatisation ferroviaire, des solutions d'électrification, des systèmes ferroviaires complets et des services d'accompagnement. Avec environ 800 employés spécialisés en Suisse et 39 600 employés dans le monde, nous façonnons la mobilité avec passion et sommes à un pas de notre temps. En tant que gestionnaire de projet, vous occuperez une position clé dans la gestion et la coordination de projets dans le domaine du développement de logiciels basés sur le cloud pour nos clients ferroviaires. Vous dirigez les projets de développement et de client dans cet environnement et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants internes ainsi qu'avec des partenaires et des clients externes pour réaliser des solutions innovantes et orientées vers le marché. Pour ce poste, nous recherchons une personne engagée avec une passion pour les projets logiciels innovants, la jouissance du travail d'équipe et l'enthousiasme pour développer des logiciels basés sur le cloud en utilisant des méthodes de projet agiles. Vos devoirs et responsabilités
• Vous planifiez, contrôlez et surveillez des projets de développement de logiciels dans l'environnement cloud. Vous veillez à ce que les projets soient achevés dans les délais et les coûts, ainsi que selon les exigences. Cela comprend également la définition des objectifs du projet, la répartition des tâches, la gestion des risques et l'assurance de la qualité.
• Vous entretenez des relations étroites avec des intervenants internes et externes, tels que des clients dans l'environnement ferroviaire, des partenaires ou d'autres départements de Siemens. Vous comprenez les exigences des intervenants et vous assurez que les solutions logicielles développées répondent à leurs besoins. Vous communiquez l'état d'avancement du projet et les résultats aux intervenants de façon adressable.
• Vous êtes l'interface entre le développement, l'ingénierie et la gestion des produits ainsi que les clients. Vous coordonnez avec ces organismes et avec l'équipe technique de base et vous assurez ainsi une mise en œuvre de projet en douceur.
• Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec notre équipe internationale de développement pour développer des solutions innovantes dans l'environnement ferroviaire. Vous identifiez les possibilités d'optimisation des processus existants et dirigez l'introduction de nouvelles technologies et méthodes. Vos talents et vos compétences
• Talent dans la structuration et le contrôle des projets de développement de logiciels dans l'environnement CloudNative
• L'enthousiasme pour les projets techniques et la capacité de communiquer des contextes techniques complexes d'une manière compréhensible
• Connaissances pratiques approfondies en technologies du cloud et expérience en architecture et programmation de systèmes logiciels basés sur le cloud dans le secteur industriel
• Ouverture aux nouveaux défis et flexibilité dans la gestion des exigences changeantes
• Expertise en génie ferroviaire souhaitable
• Études techniques terminées (ETH, FH) ou expérience pertinente
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais Si vous recherchez un rôle dynamique dans un environnement technique hautement innovant dans lequel vous contribuez de manière significative au développement et à la mise en œuvre de nos projets, alors vous êtes au bon endroit ! Nous vous offrons la possibilité de contribuer à votre expertise, de travailler avec une équipe très motivée et de conduire des solutions innovantes ensemble. Faites partie de notre équipe et façonnez l'avenir chez Siemens Mobility. Vous bénéficiez de
• une culture du travail ouverte et flexible dans l'une des plus grandes entreprises du domaine de la mobilité en Suisse
• une semaine de 40 heures avec des frais de 100 %
• au moins 5 semaines de vacances
• un lieu de travail au rythme de la technologie ferroviaire

Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. As one of the leading technology companies, Siemens employs around 6,000 people in Switzerland. With our groundbreaking solutions in the areas of building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry, we are shaping the future. Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings, it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works In our quest to revolutionize the world’s infrastructure, we are seeking a Product Manager – API Strategy & Platform for our SI Building BU Team within our SI B SW Unit Location: This position will be in Zug – Switzerland Role Overview Are you passionate about how software and APIs are reshaping the global economy? Do you believe that "openness" is a competitive moat, not just a technical feature? We are looking for a visionary Product Manager for API Strategy & Platform Interoperability to join the Building X team. In this role, you will move beyond managing point-to-point connectivity to architect the software-defined integration layers and API frameworks that underpin our digital platform strategy You will treat our APIs, SDKs, and integration layers as first-class products, driving a strategy that enables third-party developers, partners, and customers to build the future on top of Building X Your mission is to transform technical connectivity into a thriving digital ecosystem. You will lead the monetization strategy for our digital interfaces, turning "openness" into a scalable, high-growth business driver Focus Area of Responsibility Product Strategy Own the vision and lifecycle for our Northbound and Southbound interfaces, agents, MCP servers and connectors, treating them as products that deliver world-class Developer Experience (DX). Distill complex market trends in SaaS, Headless architecture, and Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) into a high-impact product roadmap Ecosystem Growth Move beyond literal connectivity to build a strategic "Openness Portfolio" that attracts customers and partners to fuel the Siemens Xcelerator ecosystem and marketplace Monetization & Value Define and execute innovative pricing strategy for our digital assets, data access, and premium integrations to drive measurable ARR from our platform capabilities Cross-Functional Leadership Act as the bridge between R&D, Customers, and Go-To-Market teams to ensure our platform is delivering value for Siemens, customers and partners Your Profile
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field; a Master’s degree is preferred
• Minimum of five years of product management experience in Internet of Things (IoT), building automation, industrial integration, or cloud connectivity
• Proven track record managing products involving protocol translation, device connectivity, gateway software, and application programming interface (API) platforms
• Experience with third-party hardware integration, partner ecosystems, and smart building technologies (HVAC, energy management)
• Knowledge of API design, SDKs, developer platforms, monetization models, and IoT/cybersecurity principles
• Strong knowledge of building automation protocols such as Niagara, BACnet, and Modbus, with familiarity in building management system (BMS) ecosystems
• You demonstrate excellent communication skills, stakeholder management abilities, and thrive in global, cross-functional teams
• Fluent English skills are required Employee benefits
• 2–3 days per week of mobile working is standard
• Mobility allowance
• Varied further training opportunities
• Access to employee share programs
• Further information about employee benefits can be found here Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our day-to-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and remote working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a good work-life balance. Learn more and find out if you are a good match with Siemens by taking our culture quiz ! “ For me, it was one of the most progressive and best application processes I have gone through in my short career so far. Within our SI CTO business, we develop innovative technologies that make buildings smarter, more sustainable, and more efficient. Our people collaborate across functions and countries to shape the future of intelligent buildings—and we’re looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment where organization, collaboration, and execution make a real difference. Your Mission As Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator , you will play a key role in enabling the Head of SI CTO and the leadership team to operate effectively. This is a hybrid role that combines executive support, project coordination, and leadership enablement in equal measure You will ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of the executive office while coordinating strategic initiatives, preparing high-quality executive content, and driving follow-up across the leadership team. Acting as a trusted partner, you will bring structure, transparency, and momentum to business priorities by connecting people, information, and actions Success in this role requires exceptional organizational skills, proactive ownership, excellent communication, and the ability to balance operational excellence with strategic coordination in a fast-paced, international environment Location: Zug, Switzerland Your responsibilities Executive & Leadership Administrative Support (approximately 50%)
• Provide proactive executive support to the Head of SI CTO by managing calendars, priorities, correspondence, and daily coordination with professionalism and discretion
• Act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring efficient communication and seamless information flow
• Draft and manage executive correspondence in German and English, demonstrating excellent judgment, cultural awareness, and an executive-level communication style
• Plan, organize, and facilitate leadership meetings, workshops, and events, including agendas, briefing materials, logistics, travel arrangements, catering, and expense reconciliation
• Anticipate business needs, identify opportunities to improve ways of working, and leverage modern productivity and AI tools to enhance efficiency and collaboration Project Coordination & Content (approximately 50%)
• Help the SI CTO Head stay focused on strategic goals by managing competing priorities and surfacing the right information at the right time
• Prepare and edit high-quality content such as decision briefings, presentations, reports, and executive summaries for leadership forums and external engagements
• Lead and coordinate high-priority and strategic initiatives for the SI CTO Head - from planning through execution, connecting workstreams and ensuring timely delivery
• Maintain action trackers, decision logs, and follow-up mechanisms across the leadership team - ensuring accountability, transparency, and consistent progress toward agreed outcomes
• Develop a deep understanding of the team's strategy, priorities, and company policy - acting as an informed resource for the SI CTO leadership team What Makes You Successful
• Proactive ownership: You anticipate needs, take initiative, and deliver high-quality results with speed and accountability
• Project coordination: You bring structure to complexity, align stakeholders, and keep priorities moving forward
• Executive communication: You communicate confidently in German and English with professionalism, discretion, cultural awareness, and the right executive tone
• Digital mindset: You embrace AI and digital tools, continuously improve ways of working, and stay curious about the business Your experience Required
• Several years of experience in Executive Assistance, Project Coordination, PMO, Business Support, Office Management, or a comparable leadership support role within an international or technology-driven environment.
• Proven ability to coordinate projects, manage multiple priorities, and drive follow-up across diverse stakeholders.
• Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and a structured, solution-oriented approach.
• Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and proactively solve problems in a dynamic environment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English, including experience preparing executive correspondence and presentations.
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Copilot) and confidence in adopting new digital and AI-based productivity tools. Preferred
• Experience working in a matrix organization with exposure to senior leadership.
• Familiarity with technology or engineering environments and an interest in understanding technical topics.
• Experience supporting strategic initiatives, governance processes, or cross-functional projects. Why Join Us? This role offers a unique opportunity to combine executive partnership with project coordination and strategic leadership support. You will work at the center of a dynamic international technology organization, collaborating closely with senior leaders and contributing to initiatives that shape the future of Siemens SI Technology. If you enjoy bringing structure to complexity, coordinating people and priorities, and turning ideas into action, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible impact while continuing to develop your own career in a collaborative and innovative environment. Employee benefits
• Mobility allowance
• Varied further training opportunities
• Access to employee share programs
• Further information about employee benefits can be found here Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our day-to-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and remote working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a good work-life balance. Learn more and find out if you are a good match with Siemens by taking our culture quiz ! “ For me, empowerment means courageously assuming responsibility, but also being heard and being able to count on genuine support in a respectful environment. ” (Head of Portfolio Sales Enablement) News and stories See for yourself how innovative technology can change the present. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Transformer le quotidien avec nous Chez Siemens, nous créons la technologie avec objectif. Au sein de notre entreprise SI CTO, nous développons des technologies innovantes qui rendent les bâtiments plus intelligents, plus durables et plus efficaces. Nos collaborateurs collaborent à travers les fonctions et les pays pour façonner l'avenir des bâtiments intelligents – et nous recherchons quelqu'un qui prospère dans un environnement dynamique où l'organisation, la collaboration et l'exécution font vraiment la différence. Votre mission En tant qu'adjointe exécutive et coordonnatrice de projet, vous jouerez un rôle clé pour permettre au chef de la CTO SI et à l'équipe de direction de fonctionner efficacement. Il s'agit d'un rôle hybride qui combine le soutien exécutif, la coordination des projets et la capacité de leadership dans des proportions égales. Vous assurerez le bon fonctionnement quotidien du bureau de la haute direction tout en coordonnant les initiatives stratégiques, en préparant un contenu de haute qualité pour la haute direction et en menant un suivi dans toute l'équipe de direction. En tant que partenaire de confiance, vous apporterez la structure, la transparence et l'élan aux priorités des entreprises en reliant les personnes, l'information et les actions.Le succès de ce rôle exige des compétences organisationnelles exceptionnelles, une appropriation proactive, une excellente communication et la capacité d'équilibrer l'excellence opérationnelle avec la coordination stratégique dans un environnement international rapide.
• Fournir un soutien exécutif proactif au chef du CTO SI en gérant les calendriers, les priorités, la correspondance et la coordination quotidienne avec professionnalisme et discrétion
• Agir en tant que point de contact fiable pour les intervenants internes et externes, en assurant une communication efficace et un flux d'information fluide
• Rédiger et gérer la correspondance de l'exécutif en allemand et en anglais, démontrant un excellent jugement, une sensibilisation culturelle et un style de communication de l'exécutif
• Planifier, organiser et faciliter les réunions de direction, les ateliers et les événements, y compris les ordres du jour, les documents d'information, la logistique, les arrangements relatifs aux voyages, la restauration et le rapprochement des dépenses
• Prévoir les besoins des entreprises, cerner les possibilités d'améliorer les méthodes de travail et tirer parti des outils modernes de productivité et d'IA pour améliorer l'efficacité et la collaboration Coordination et contenu du projet (environ 50 %)
• Aider le chef du SI CTO à se concentrer sur les objectifs stratégiques en gérant des priorités concurrentes et en faisant face à la bonne information au bon moment
• Préparer et modifier un contenu de haute qualité, comme des séances d'information sur les décisions, des présentations, des rapports et des résumés pour les forums de leadership et les engagements externes
• Diriger et coordonner les initiatives stratégiques et hautement prioritaires pour le chef de la CTO SI - de la planification à l'exécution, des liens entre les secteurs de travail et de l'exécution en temps opportun
• Maintenir des processus de suivi des mesures, des registres de décision et des mécanismes de suivi dans l'ensemble de l'équipe de direction - assurer la responsabilisation, la transparence et des progrès constants vers des résultats convenus
• Développer une compréhension approfondie de la stratégie, des priorités et de la politique de l'entreprise de l'équipe - agir comme une ressource éclairée pour l'équipe de direction de l'OIAC SI Ce qui vous fait réussir
• Propriété proactive: Vous anticipez les besoins, prenez des initiatives et produisez des résultats de haute qualité avec rapidité et responsabilité
• Coordination du projet: Vous apportez la structure à la complexité, alignez les intervenants et faites avancer les priorités
• Communication exécutive: Vous communiquez avec confiance en allemand et en anglais avec professionnalisme, discrétion, sensibilisation culturelle et le bon ton exécutif
• L'état d'esprit numérique: Vous embrassez l'IA et les outils numériques, améliorez continuellement les méthodes de travail, et restez curieux de l'entreprise Votre expérience Obligatoire
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans les domaines de l'aide aux cadres supérieurs, de la coordination de projets, du BGP, de l'appui aux entreprises, de la gestion de bureau ou d'un rôle d'appui à la direction comparable dans un contexte international ou technologique.
• Capacité éprouvée de coordonner les projets, de gérer plusieurs priorités et de diriger le suivi auprès de divers intervenants.
• Des compétences organisationnelles solides avec une excellente attention aux détails et une approche structurée et orientée vers la solution.
• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, d'exercer un jugement solide et de résoudre les problèmes de façon proactive dans un environnement dynamique.
• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en allemand et en anglais, y compris l'expérience de préparation de la correspondance et des présentations des cadres.
• Forte compétence en Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Copilot) et confiance dans l'adoption de nouveaux outils de productivité numériques et basés sur l'IA. Préféré
• Expérience de travail dans une organisation matricielle exposée à la haute direction.
• Connaissance des environnements technologiques ou d'ingénierie et intérêt à comprendre les sujets techniques.
• Expérience à l'appui d'initiatives stratégiques, de processus de gouvernance ou de projets interfonctionnels. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Ce rôle offre une occasion unique de combiner le partenariat exécutif avec la coordination des projets et le soutien au leadership stratégique. Vous travaillerez au centre d'une organisation technologique internationale dynamique, en collaborant étroitement avec des dirigeants et en contribuant à des initiatives qui façonnent l'avenir de Siemens SI Technology. Si vous aimez rendre la structure plus complexe, coordonner les personnes et les priorités, et transformer les idées en actions, vous aurez la possibilité de faire un impact visible tout en continuant à développer votre propre carrière dans un environnement collaboratif et innovant. Avantages sociaux
• 2–3 jours par semaine de travail mobile est standard
• Indemnité de mobilité
• Autres possibilités de formation
• Accès aux programmes de partage des employés
• Pour plus d'informations sur les avantages sociaux des employés, voir ici Notre culture d'entreprise – votre nouvel environnement de travail La culture de Siemens Suisse est plus qu'un simple environnement de travail – elle est au cœur de nos interactions quotidiennes et la clé de notre succès. Siemens Suisse offre un environnement de travail orienté vers l'avenir caractérisé par l'innovation, la durabilité et le développement personnel. Nous sommes caractérisés par la responsabilité personnelle, l'égalité des chances et la diversité, à laquelle chaque employé peut contribuer de manière authentique. Les modèles de travail flexibles et le travail à distance sont une réalité pour nous et permettent à nos employés d'atteindre un bon équilibre entre le travail et la vie personnelle. En savoir plus et savoir si vous êtes un bon match avec Siemens en prenant notre quiz de culture ! Pour moi, l'autonomisation signifie assumer courageusement la responsabilité, mais aussi être entendu et pouvoir compter sur un soutien véritable dans un environnement respectueux. Actualités et histoires Découvrez par vous-même comment la technologie innovante peut changer le présent. Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur les projets qui peuvent être mis en œuvre à l'aide de la technologie Siemens, voici quelques exemples actuels. Foire aux questions et coordonnées Vous trouverez ici une collection de questions fréquemment posées et un moyen de nous contacter directement. J'ai hâte de recevoir votre candidature. Acquisition de talents Isidora Votre chemin vers Siemens - Comment nous embauchons Informations pour les agences de recrutement: Siemens n'accepte pas les candidatures des agences de recrutement pour ce poste. Merci de votre compréhension.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Insieme ai nostri clienti, uniamo i mondi reali e digitali Con tecnologia, software e servizi per edifici intelligenti, trasformiamo il quotidiano per tutti. Combinando i mondi reali e digitali, possiamo permettere ai nostri clienti di raggiungere i loro obiettivi di decarbonizzazione, abbassare i costi operativi e creare esperienze occupanti di livello mondiale per la loro gente. Non si tratta solo di migliorare gli edifici, si tratta di creare ambienti efficienti, sicuri, adattabili e sostenibili, che migliorano il modo in cui il mondo vive e lavora. Nella nostra ricerca di rivoluzionare l'infrastruttura del mondo, stiamo cercando un Senior Technical Program Manager per il nostro team di Software Factory all'interno della nostra SI B SW & Digital Services Unit presso SI Buildings. Posizione: Questa posizione sarà sia in Zug - Svizzera, Erlangen - Germania o Monaco di Baviera - Germania Role Panoramica Sei appassionato di portare la struttura in complessitÃ e orchestrare squadre interfunzionali per trasformare in realtÃ visioni tecniche ambiziose? Stiamo cercando un esperto Senior Program Manager per unire il team di Software Factory all'interno di Software e Servizi Digitali presso SI Buildings. Il ruolo sarà responsabile della gestione di programmi tecnici complessi e interfunzionali dalla definizione iniziale attraverso l'implementazione, il rollout, l'adozione e il completamento. Il Direttore del Programma Tecnico Senior prenderà la proprietà end-to-end dei programmi assegnati, mettendo insieme le prospettive tecniche, di prodotto, operative e aziendali necessarie per la consegna di successo. Il ruolo richiede una forte comprensione tecnica, combinata con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente attraverso la gestione dei prodotti, l'ingegneria, l'architettura, la piattaforma, i temi regionali e aziendali. I programmi possono includere l'implementazione e lo scaling di soluzioni software in tutte le regioni, l'evoluzione dei prodotti software e delle funzionalità della piattaforma, la disponibilità di imprese, l'interoperabilità e le iniziative di trasformazione tecnologica. Si tratta di un ruolo di gestione del programma pratico focalizzato sulla creazione di struttura, coordinare i team, gestire le dipendenze, risolvere i blocchi, e garantire che i programmi forniscono i risultati previsti. Le nuove responsabilità
• Prendere la proprietà end-to-end di programmi tecnici, dalla definizione iniziale e la pianificazione attraverso l'implementazione, rollout, adozione e completamento. Tradurre gli obiettivi del programma in flussi di lavoro chiari, piani, pietre miliari, responsabilità, dipendenze e risultati attesi
• Coordinare più team e iniziative tra gestione dei prodotti, ingegneria, architettura, servizi di piattaforma, dati, operazioni e organizzazioni regionali
• Assicurarsi che i requisiti tecnici, di prodotto, di business, di cliente e operativi siano considerati in tutto il programma.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i responsabili dei prodotti e i team tecnici per comprendere le priorità, i requisiti, i vincoli, le offerte e le esigenze di consegna
• Mantenere una visione completa del programma e garantire che i singoli flussi di lavoro rimangano allineati con gli obiettivi generali.
• Traccia i progressi, i rischi, i problemi, le decisioni e le dipendenze, e assicura che vengano adottate azioni appropriate per mantenere il programma in movimento. Identificare le lacune, i bloccanti e le dipendenze trasversali presto e lavorare con i team competenti per definire soluzioni pratiche
• Stabilire modi chiari di lavorare, la proprietà, la governance, processi decisionali e percorsi di escalation
• allineamento del supporto tra software globale e direzione del prodotto e requisiti regionali, clienti o specifici del mercato
• Assicurarsi che le soluzioni siano preparate non solo per la consegna tecnica, ma anche per rollout, adozione, funzionamento, supporto e scaling futuro
• Definire e monitorare le misure di successo del programma pertinenti
• Fornire una comunicazione chiara e strutturata agli stakeholder per quanto riguarda i progressi, i rischi, le decisioni, le dipendenze e i prossimi passi
• Corso di laurea o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo
• Esperienza a lungo termine nella gestione dei programmi tecnici, nella gestione dei programmi, nella fornitura di software, nella trasformazione tecnologica o in un ruolo paragonabile
• Esperienza dimostrata che gestisce programmi complessi e interfunzionali che coinvolgono più squadre e dipendenze tecniche.
• Prova capacità di prendere la proprietà dei programmi end-to-end piuttosto che gestire solo i singoli compiti, programmi, o progetti isolati
• Forte comprensione tecnica dei prodotti software, soluzioni digitali, servizi cloud, API, dati, integrazioni o ambienti tecnologici correlati
• Capacità di partecipare con fiducia in discussioni tecniche, pur comprendendo anche le considerazioni di prodotto, di business, di funzionamento e del cliente
• Esperienza di lavoro con product manager, team di ingegneria del software, architetti, team di piattaforma, team operativi, organizzazioni regionali e stakeholder aziendali
• Forte pianificazione, coordinamento, problem solving, gestione della dipendenza e capacità di gestione del rischio
• Capacità di portare la struttura a argomenti ambigui e tradurli in azioni chiare, responsabilità e piani di consegna
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.
• Esperienza di lavoro in organizzazioni distribuite, internazionali o matrici
• Capacità di gestire diversi flussi di lavoro interconnessi mantenendo l'attenzione sul risultato del programma generale
